purpose: Guarantee that newly generated Havenwild surfaces contain deterministic discrete Level 0/1/2 landforms that can resolve into the certified structural cliff renderer and collision system.

rules.structuralLevelRole: Level 2 is the default inland raised-platform authority; Level 1 is reserved for coastal cliff bands and carved directional-ramp middle cells.
rules.fallbackGuarantee: If the normal deterministic landform classifier yields zero structural boundaries on a landmass with eligible land, stamp one bounded deterministic plateau around the strongest available land anchor.
rules.roadAndSettlementProtection: Roads, constructed paths, bridges and reserved settlement/path zones receive a two-cell structural safety buffer so fresh PCG cliffs do not cut directly through authored civic/transport surfaces.
rules.connectorGuarantee: Inland raised components terminate as direct Level-2 to Level-0 faces. Deterministic south-facing gateways carve complete six-cell Level-2 -> Level-1 -> Level-0 MountainPath corridors for the authored 3x4 LPC ramps. Coastal one-level south faces use authored ladder connectors instead of the large ramp.
